title: XVII-XX: form and final cause; inequality of things
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE, On ye world, follows. belonging toward ye first night, plus belonging toward ye six days — discretely they stand as called ye works belonging toward ye beginning. Regarded jointly they come under ye name WORLD: that same which stand as regarded either jointly or discretely — there will follow creatures. And these things concerning creation commonly: XXII. that same there may be order plus harmony in ye universe — inequality belonging toward things stands as not out from matter but out from Gods most wise ordination. XX. Revelation 4:11. Romans 11:36; plus ye good belonging toward creatures subordinated to Gods glory — Proverbs 16:4; — the final cause belonging toward creation stands as Gods glory. XVIII. From that same which God stands as called FOUNTAIN. The form belonging toward creation stands as ye divine command itself or fiat — Psalm 33:9. XXVII.
pass_b_english: XXVII. The form of creation is the divine command itself or fiat — Psalm 33:9. From which God is called FOUNTAIN. XVIII. The final cause of creation is Gods glory, and the good of creatures subordinated to Gods glory — Proverbs 16:4; Romans 11:36; Revelation 4:11.
XX. Inequality of things is not from matter but from Gods most wise ordination, that there may be order and harmony in the universe.

XXII. And these things concerning creation commonly: there will follow creatures, which are regarded either jointly or discretely. Regarded jointly they come under the name WORLD: discretely they are called the works of the beginning, of the first night, and of the six days. CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE, On the world, follows.
source_text: XXVII. Forma creationis est ipse divinus jussus seu fiat — Psal. XXXIII.9; II Pet.? Ex quo Deus FONS appellatur. XVIII. Finalis causa creationis est gloria Dei, et bonum creaturarum subordinatum gloriae Dei — Prov. XVI.4; Rom. XI.36; Apoc. IV.11. XX. Rerum inaequalitas non est a materia, sed a Dei sapientissima ordinatione, ut sit ordo et harmonia in universo. XXII. Atque haec de creatione communiter: sequentur creaturae, quae spectantur vel conjunctim, vel discretim. Conjunctim spectatae MUNDI nomine veniunt: discretim appellantur opera tum principii, tum primae noctis, tum sex dierum. CAPUT VICESIMUM QUINTUM, De mundo, sequitur.
